ChatGPT
What they did
Tom used ChatGPT Work on mobile while playing with his dog. The agent asked for a few personal details, then opened a remote browser session for him to enter payment details.
How it went
He booked the flight.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Find me a flight from [origin] to [destination] on [date] under [budget], preferring [airline or time of day]. Ask me for any personal details you need, then take me to a secure browser session to enter payment myself. Pause and show me the flight and price before the final purchase step.
